page: Amazon Web Services m7g.12xlarge is a general-purpose cloud instance built on the AWS Nitro System and powered by the 64-bit ARM Neoverse-V1 AWS Graviton3 architecture. The instance features 48 dedicated physical cores with a 1:1 mapping to 48 vCPUs running at 2.6 GHz. It includes a cache layout of 64 KB L1 data cache, 1.0 MB L2 cache, and 32 MB L3 cache per core cluster, alongside hardware AES cryptography acceleration. Backed by 192.0 GB of system memory at a consistent 4.0 GB per core ratio, the instance provides 22 Gbps of baseline network bandwidth. It contains no attached local NVMe storage and no discrete hardware accelerators.

Benchmark results demonstrate high multi-threaded scaling and memory throughput across intensive server workloads. While single-core tests show midrange performance with a Geekbench score of 1503.0 and stress-ng score of 1533.28, parallel throughput places firmly in the upper 25% tier, achieving a multi-core Geekbench score of 19294.0 and stress-ng score of 73482.54. Memory subsystem performance ranks in the top 10% on PassMark with 3145.6 points, delivering uncached read speeds of 252.61 GB/sec and write speeds of 118.4 GB/sec. Data processing highlights include 79.78 million Redis SET operations per second, 65.64 GB/sec static web serving throughput, and a Clang compilation score of 51379.0.

Hardware efficiency stems from Graviton3 architecture, which offers high parallel compute density per watt without simultaneous multithreading overhead. However, the architecture excludes x86 vector extensions such as AVX-512, AMX, and SHA-NI, which bounds single-threaded execution and token generation rates on smaller language models to lower percentiles. The absence of local disk requires external network storage integration for persistence.

The m7g.12xlarge is suited for multi-threaded enterprise services, large-scale Redis in-memory caches, software compilation clusters, container fleets, and relational database servers running on ARM-compatible software stacks.
description: Amazon Web Services m7g.12xlarge is a general-purpose Nitro instance driven by 48 dedicated 64-bit ARM Neoverse-V1 cores running at 2.6 GHz, coupled with 192.0 GB of system memory and 22 Gbps baseline network throughput. Operating without local instance storage or dedicated GPUs, the system maintains a 4:1 memory-to-vCPU ratio. In synthetic and application benchmarks, m7g.12xlarge yields top-quartile multi-core compute and top-decile memory performance, achieving a Geekbench multi-core score of 19294.0, uncached memory reads of 252.61 GB/sec, and 79.78 million Redis SET operations per second. While single-threaded tasks show midrange efficiency due to modest clock frequency and the absence of x86 vector instruction sets, its dedicated-core ARM architecture delivers high density for concurrent throughput. The instance is suited for high-concurrency microservices, static web delivery, continuous integration builds, and in-memory key-value stores.
